Matching uses WhatsApp display names, not phone numbers. Case, spacing and emoji are normalized. Different contacts with the same normalized name share one rule; duplicate selections never replace an existing rule. Group calls remain manual.
Automatic recording requires a matching contact and verified one-to-one call. Group classification is not verified yet, so current calls ask first.
No contacts selected. Use Add contact to choose one without granting access to your address book.

Review why each access is needed before enabling it. Microphone records audio; notifications keep the recording indicator and Stop visible. Granting access never starts recording. Continue to Home for manual controls; completing this guide does not prove call capture or remote audio. Obtain participant consent before recording.

If Android blocks accessibility or notification access, open App info and look for Allow restricted settings in its menu. Enable only for this trusted build, then return to the relevant access screen. Options vary by device; managed-device policies may forbid changes. Missing adapters in this build cannot be enabled through Settings.

In Samsung Settings, find Background usage limits. Remove WACR from Sleeping and Deep sleeping apps, then add it to Never sleeping apps if offered. Menu paths vary by One UI. The Android battery list below does not open that Samsung list directly, and this app cannot verify Samsung sleeping-list membership. No generic battery result marks that manual step complete.
Call adapters are declared and enabled. This check does not prove detection accuracy, remote audio or recording reliability.

Exports a bounded, redacted event log and technical app/device/setup status. Text values and arbitrary log keys are hashed even in debug builds. No recordings, contacts, transcripts, database, keys or raw crash files are included. Call traces and capability results are included only when implemented; unavailable results are reported as unavailable.

You choose the ZIP destination. Select an on-device folder for offline storage; another document provider may sync its own files. Nothing is shared automatically. If export is interrupted, an incomplete document may remain at the chosen destination.
Choose a destination to create a redacted ZIP.
Waiting for your document selection. Cancel does not export or delete your data.
Latest export completed: diagnostics saved to the selected document.

Export failed. Recordings are unchanged; source logs were not cleared. An incomplete ZIP may remain at the selected destination; remove it using Files and retry. If the picker did not open, check that a document-provider app is enabled.
